_about: Reel n Creel's fishing rods (docs/FISHING.md). Each rod hooks fish of two size tiers only: 'classes' [lower, upper], drawn by 'chances' [lower, upper], counting only a tier that has a species suiting the water at the bobber (one tier alone gets every bite; none, and nothing bites). Each level of Luck of the Sea multiplies the upper tier's chance by 'luck_of_the_sea'. 'cast' is the rod's throw against vanilla's. 'reel_speed' is how fast a reeled fish of each tier comes in, in blocks per tick. Holding use with no line out charges the cast over 'cast.charge_ticks', and the bobber's launch is vanilla's times the rod's cast times a power from 'cast.min_power' (a tap) to 'cast.full_power' (full charge). Holding use with the line out and nothing on it winds the bobber in at 'wind_speed' blocks per tick. (0.17.0) 'treasure' per rod is the chance of a treasure with a landed fish (the 'treasure' block), and 'trades' what fishermen buy. A datapack may override this file; /reload applies it.

fight._about: The fight: after the first reel a hooked fish RESTs (calm), and at the end of every stage ROLLS what it does next and for how long: from REST it rests on a little or PULLs; from a PULL it RUNs (taking line: danger, do not reel) or settles back to REST, more likely to run when fresh and when the player reeled through the pull; a RUN always eases off through a PULL-level easing before a rest. Its running time may never pass run_cap of the fight so far. Its stamina (running_ticks by tier times size_scale by size) drains in pulls and runs, faster reeled against; spent, it finishes its stage and is beaten. While the player reels, the reel clicks at the fish's state's gap (click_ticks: rest, pull, run); only reeling a running fish can snap the line: snap_reel_ticks reeled ticks in one run (each tick let go takes one back). A fighting fish is reeled in at a pace that brings it to the bank about as it tires (reel_pace, pace_tail_ticks); a resting fish at the bank with land_below of its stamina or less is landed, a fresher one bolts into a pull. Ticks are game ticks (20 a second). Each number is described in docs/FISHING.md, 'The fight'.

treasure._about: (0.17.0) When a fish is landed with one of these rods there is a chance of a treasure as well, thrown to the player: the rod's 'treasure' above, times (1 + luck_of_the_sea x the rod's Luck of the Sea level). What comes is the loot table data/creel/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/treasure.json. A lost fish gives nothing.

trades._about: (0.17.0) Every fisherman villager buys these for emeralds, as extra offers on top of vanilla's (added the first time a player interacts with him, kept at every level, never taking a vanilla offer's place; an offer already there for the same item and an emerald is left as it is). 'buys': the item and how many of it pay 1 emerald. 'max_uses' (before a restock), 'xp' (the villager's trade xp) and 'price_multiplier' (reputation and demand) are vanilla's for a novice sell trade. A change applies to fishermen that do not have the offer yet.
